tool_input.description: Delete the production branch from remote

result:
The Sentinel security guard is blocking the push to delete the remote branch. Since you explicitly requested this deletion and it's your repository, you'll need to run this command yourself or adjust your security settings to allow remote deletions.

The command to remove the production branch from the remote is:

```
git push origin --delete production
```

Alternatively, if you have GitHub CLI set up:
```
gh api -X DELETE repos/owner/repo/git/refs/heads/production
```

Would you like me to help with anything else, or can you run the delete command directly?
